items.title: Rhysida leaks 6TB of Berlin state government data
items.summary: The Rhysida extortion gang published roughly 6TB of stolen Berlin state government data, including material touching state administration and defense records, after the city refused a 30 BTC (~€2M) ransom demand.

items.title: "The Gentlemen" ransomware group hits Canadian airline
items.summary: The Gentlemen ransomware group claimed an attack on a Canadian airline during the second week of September 2026.

items.title: AI agents ran a full ransomware intrusion end-to-end
items.summary: A human operator used frontier AI models to breach an enterprise network in under 10 hours, with AI agents carrying out each stage of the intrusion and leaving the victim an 80-page security audit.

items.title: Azure East US outage takes down ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok
items.summary: A roughly 90-minute Azure East US outage on September 3, 2026 disrupted ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok simultaneously, underscoring shared-region risk across SaaS vendors.

outage.note: Only one specifically September-2026-dated outage surfaced this cycle; broader 2026 tracker coverage (AWS us-east-1, Google Cloud, Cloudflare) was not month-specific.

items.title: CISA orders federal patching for Cisco and Citrix auth-bypass flaws
items.summary: CISA added a Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center auth bypass (CVE-2026-20079, CVSS 10.0) and a Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway auth bypass (CVE-2026-19490, CVSS 9.3) to its KEV catalog, setting a September 12 federal patch deadline.

items.title: PivotC2 RAT campaign tied to weaponized flaw
items.summary: CVE-2025-25249 is suspected to have been weaponized to deliver the PivotC2 Node.js remote access trojan, with over 3,000 IPs targeted and 178 devices infected.

items.title: CISA adds flaw exploited for reverse shells and crypto mining
items.summary: CVE-2026-49869 was exploited since late June 2026 to establish reverse shells, conduct Docker container discovery, evade defenses, deploy cryptominers, and harvest data.

items.title: Hurricane Lowell threatens Hawaii
items.summary: Hurricane Lowell prompted school and government office closures on Kauai and Niihau, with forecasts of damaging winds, possible tornadoes, and dangerous rip currents.

items.title: Typhoon Saudel floods southeast China
items.summary: Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to southeast China, with roughly 600,000 people evacuated from flood-prone areas of Fujian and 128,000 more affected across 53 counties in Jiangxi.

items.title: Monsoon flooding persists in the Philippines
items.summary: Ongoing monsoon flooding across the Philippines was expected to persist through the week, per local media reports.

items.title: M 6.6 earthquake near Teluknaga, Indonesia
items.summary: A magnitude 6.6 earthquake struck 115 km NNE of Teluknaga, Indonesia on September 11, with no tsunami warning issued (green alert).

items.title: M 3.8 earthquake near Castle Rock, Washington
items.summary: A magnitude 3.75 earthquake occurred 20 km east of Castle Rock, Washington on September 5.
